event_confirmation: Company press release dated 2026-10-15, quoted on biopharmawatch: Emergent 'will host a conference call on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. eastern time' to discuss Q3 2026 results (https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/EBS/emergent-biosolutions-q3-2026-financial-results). EarningsWhispers lists it as confirmed for 2026-11-02 after the close (https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/EBS). A 5pm call means an amc release, so the window is the 2026-11-02 close to the 2026-11-03 close. The original release was not reached on the company IR site or EDGAR, which has no 8-K for it, as is normal for a date notice.
conviction_note: The pieces roughly offset. The company has beaten its own quarterly revenue guide in both 2026 quarters (Q1 above the top end, Q2 $234.3m against $170-185m), and 18.9% of shares outstanding is short at 9 days to cover. Against that, the FY guide already prices a steep H2 naloxone drop, and the last two large moves (-26.6%, -29.6%) were the full-year guide overriding the quarter. So p_up is 52 on a 20% absolute move, +0.8 scaled. The findings sum to +1.5 and the gap is small; neither number claims an edge.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue: company guide $110-130m (8-K ex99, 2026-08-05, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001367644/000136764426000080/ebs202606-30ex99er.htm); consensus $123.2m (Benzinga) and $123.33m (EarningsWhispers, https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/EBS); EPS consensus -$0.40 / -$0.45. Two estimate sources agree on revenue, and the consensus sits above the guide midpoint of $120m. FY2026 guide: revenue $645-675m, adj. EBITDA $130-150m, Commercial (naloxone) -20-25% y/y, MCM flat to slightly down (HCW deck 2026-09-14).
positioning_check: Short interest 9.68m shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 9.0 days to cover on 1.07m average volume, against 51.27m shares outstanding (~18.9% of shares outstanding; float is higher-percent), per https://massive.com/quote/ebs read 2026-11-02. It was 9.29m / 8.3 DTC on 2026-09-30 and 10.3m / 19.9% of float on 2026-07-17 (equibles), so the short is crowded and roughly flat to slightly building into the print. Baseline: 25d skew is null (not computable); put/call OI 0.16 on 1,610 contracts total, call-heavy but tiny; ATM spread 28.6% of mid, so the option market is thin. Event-implied move is 16.5% against a median historical reaction of 29.6%. Spot $6.67 is -52% from the 52-week high, -7.9% over 20 days and +5.2% over 5 days.

findings.finding: Emergent has beaten its own quarterly revenue guide in both 2026 quarters: Q1 $156.1m against a $135-155m guide ('above the high-end') and Q2 $234.3m against $170-185m, a 27% beat on the top end. Q3 is guided at $110-130m, consensus is $123.2-123.3m, and repeating the pattern implies roughly $130m+, about 5% above consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026's 27% beat over its own guide came with a FY cut and impairment, and the stock fell 29.58%. Q1 2026's small beat with adjusted guidance raised gave +2.92%. The quarterly beat has not driven the stock; the FY guide has.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $123m is already above the guide midpoint, so some beat is expected. If the market priced the Q2-sized beat habit, consensus would sit at or above the $130m top end. Q3 MCM revenue is lumpy USG/international delivery timing, which analysts model off the guide.
findings.independence: Q2 beat from a separate document: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001367644/000136764426000080/ebs202606-30ex99er.htm (2026-08-05). Both are company releases, so this is the same issuer's track record and not an outside series.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide (revenue $645-675m, Commercial -20-25% on FY2025 naloxone of $226.1m) implies H2 naloxone of only about $75-86m against H1's $95.3m (Q1 $42.9m, Q2 $52.4m) and Q3 2025's roughly $74.9m. Management cited 'intensifying competition', new 4mg OTC and 10mg Rx entrants, more aggressive pricing and an overdose market 'trending lower than expected'. CDC's provisional overdose deaths are down 12.3% y/y for the 12 months to March 2026. A second FY cut is the downside path; a held guide with a Q3 beat is the upside path.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance drove the last big prints: 2026-02-26 initial FY26 guide -26.58%, 2026-08-05 FY cut -29.58%, 2025-10-29 +36.6%. This line moves the stock about 25-37%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the guide was re-based 3 months ago and the deck repeated it on 2026-09-14 without reaffirming or cutting. The open question is whether H2 naloxone falls even faster than a ~25% sequential drop. If a second cut were priced, the stock would be making new lows; it is +50% off its 52-week low and up 5% in 5 days.
findings.independence: CDC provisional overdose deaths -12.3% y/y (https://cdc.gov/overdose-prevention/data-research/facts-stats/index.html, released Aug 2026). This is a macro proxy and not a company number, and it was largely known when the August guide was set.

findings.finding: In Q3 Emergent repurchased $75m principal of its 3.875% 2028 senior notes for $68m of cash, which implies a roughly $7m gain on extinguishment (before unamortized costs, ~$0.13 per share) and about $2.9m a year of interest saved. It also takes Q3 cash down from the $139.7m June level. Net leverage was 1.9x against a 5.25x covenant first tested at Q3. $364.7m of notes remain due 2028-08-15, with term-loan springing maturity 91 days earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on a debt-buyback gain; the April 2026 term-loan refinancing ($20.5m loss on extinguishment) came with a +2.92% print.
findings.why_not_priced: The buyback was disclosed in the 2026-09-14 deck, so the fact is public. The GAAP gain may not be in a -$0.40/-$0.45 EPS consensus, but it is below the line with no path to the guide. The lower cash balance could read badly next to the 2028 maturity wall. On the financing question: the cash bought debt at a discount and deleveraging, with no covenant pressure, so the sign is mildly positive.
findings.independence: Repurchase amount and cash cost: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001367644/000136764426000091/hcw9-14x26ebs2026irconfe.htm (2026-09-14). The notes' fair value of $408.4m on $439.7m principal is from the 10-Q.

findings.finding: About 18.9% of shares outstanding is short (9.68m of 51.27m at the 2026-10-15 settlement), at 9.0 days to cover, on a $6.4m-a-day name. That is a crowded short into a print with a habitual top-line beat, so a non-negative release has a squeeze mechanism of its own.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Three of the last seven prints moved +34% to +37% (2025-05, 2025-08, 2025-10), in line with forced covering on good news. Two of the last three fell 27-30% on guide cuts, so the short has also been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public, but the event-implied move of 16.5% sits well below the 29.6% median realised reaction. The option market is not pricing the squeeze-or-collapse tails this name has produced.
findings.independence: Equibles: 10.3m short, 19.9% of float, 8.0 DTC at 2026-07-17 (https://equibles.com/stocks/ebs/shortinterest). Same underlying FINRA data, so this confirms persistence, not an independent signal.

findings.finding: BARDA awarded a ~$24m CYFENDUS anthrax vaccine contract modification on 2026-09-01, after the 2026-08-05 Q3 guide. Delivery timing is not specified, so it could add to Q3 or Q4 MCM revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: MCM delivery timing drove the Q2 2026 beat (smallpox +150%, BAT $54.1m), and the stock still fell on guidance.
findings.why_not_priced: Public via an 8-K, but small ($24m against a $110-130m quarter), and it may already sit inside the 'flat to slightly down' MCM FY assumption. If it were a Q3 delivery the market had not counted, consensus would sit at the guide's top.
findings.independence: The deck lists it as a Q3 award: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001367644/000136764426000091/hcw9-14x26ebs2026irconfe.htm. Same issuer.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-16 Emergent announced that CFO Richard Lindahl retires on 2026-12-31. Treasurer Frank Vargo becomes interim CFO on 2027-01-01, so no permanent successor is named in the middle of the turnaround and ahead of the 2028 note maturity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved print on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for 2.5 weeks and largely priced. The residual is the call: whether a departing CFO frames 2028 refinancing or a guide change.

findings.finding: Pomerantz has an open securities-fraud investigation, announced 2026-08-27 and re-circulated in September, tied to the Q2 NARCAN impairment and the 29.58% fall. It is an overhang, not a filed suit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A 2025 Pomerantz settlement of $40m on an earlier case did not mark a print.
findings.why_not_priced: Boilerplate plaintiff-firm notice, public for two months, so it is priced unless the 10-Q adds a disclosed suit.

findings.finding: Two insider sales in October: director DeGolyer sold 17,800 shares at $7.09 on 2026-10-07 (10b5-1, to cover RSU tax), and SVP Williams sold 3,000 at $6.53 on 2026-10-01 (10b5-1). Both are small and plan-driven.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved print on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: These are public Form 4s. 10b5-1 tax-cover sales carry almost no information.

outside_window.finding: $364.7m of 3.875% senior notes mature 2028-08-15, and the term loan springs forward 91 days before that if conditions are not met. Refinancing is a 2027 event unless it is announced with the print.

baseline_tension: Skew is not computable and the option market is thin (OI 1,610, 29% ATM spread). The 16.5% implied move sits well under the 29.6% median realised reaction. The beat habit and the crowded short lean up, while the 20-day -7.9% and the naloxone trend lean down, so the evidence offsets and does not cut against the baseline.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1: the quarterly-beat finding went from +1.5 to +1.0, because this name sold a 27% beat over its own guide for -29.6% on the FY guide.

Lessons 2, 4, 7 and 8 left the rest standing: the bond-buyback gain was already sized as a below-the-line fraction and signed after asking what the cash bought (deleveraging at a discount). The negative guidance finding stays small given the ~19% short at 9 DTC. abs_move_pct stays at 20 (above the 16.5 implied) for thin coverage and history.
